description.value: Island Link (Island Express Bus) intercity bus connecting Nanaimo, Courtenay, and Campbell River. Bicycles are not accepted on any Island Link vehicle — the operator's baggage policy explicitly restricts bicycles due to vehicle space limitations, with no boxed or bagged exception. Confirm current schedule at islandlinkbus.com before travel.
